analysis.title: GS Early Morning Research Recap: Ratings and Target Price Changes - November 17, 2026 as of 5:30 AM ET
key_insights: UNFI upgraded to Buy from Neutral. GS calls it an underappreciated self-help-driven growth story levered to the current food inflation backdrop. Target price raised to $60 from $49 against a $48.39 last price (24% upside).
SBM Offshore (SBMO.AS) initiated at Buy on the thesis that it benefits from a deepwater capex wave.
TOYO TIRE (5105.T) downgraded to Neutral from Buy after a downward revision to company profit guidance. Target cut to ¥4,800 from ¥5,500.

XP Inc. (XP) target cut to $27 from $31 after 3Q26 results described as in-line across the board, with a new buyback and dividend program. The $27 target implies 82% upside to the $14.83 last price, and the rating is Buy.
GS strategy published its 2027 US Equity Outlook, titled 'The beginning of the middle' (Snider). GS Precious Analyst published a 2027 outlook titled 'It Is 2022 Again' (Thomas).
GS Economics published a 2027 Global Rates Outlook titled 'A Better Buffer' (Marshall, Freycenet and others).
Canada Economics Comment: another downside surprise, with all core inflation measures at or below 2%.
Airlines: GS Transportation published a note framing the impact of the nationwide FAA ground stop (O'Brien).

Diamondback Energy (FANG) announced plans to acquire assets from Double Eagle for approximately $5B. Canadian Natural Resources (CNQ) announced a C$2.53B acquisition of Advantage Energy to expand its natural gas footprint.
Nextpower (NXT) held a Capital Markets Day. GS says FY2030 targets rose materially despite a weaker near-term margin cadence, and reiterates Buy.
South Korea Technology HBM tracker for Nov. 2026: GS revised up its SK Hynix HBM revenue and operating profit expectations.

China data points: October online retail GMV -3.6%. China NEV weekly orders -23% wow and -4% yoy, with retail NEV penetration at a new high of 75%. Double 11 GMV growth moderated, with heightened competition and a profitability headwind.

Earnings and event takes: Aramark (ARMK) 4Q26 guidance looks conservative, Maintain Buy. Tyson (TSN) improving beef trends are the key FY27 growth driver. Church & Dwight (CHD) will buy a 45% stake in BALI Treatment, reiterate Buy. American Eagle (AEO) 3Q26 preview raises comp estimates on better 3Q trends. Capital One (COF) October stats show DQs down YoY and card loan growth improving.
Housing: GS Housing Market Activity Scale for the week of November 8 rose 2% sequentially as rates moved off their recent peak.
Goldman's upcoming events include an oil outlook webinar Nov 18 and a US equity flow and positioning webinar Nov 18 at 1 PM ET.

Accelevation Holdings (ACCV) 3Q reported: beat, with order strength supporting revenue acceleration next year.
